decisions.reason: As a newly launched handle family with no negative signal and a fit to the firm's broad architectural hardware range, it is likely to be retained while management waits for clearer market feedback.
The mitred handle family supports the firm's design-led positioning, and absent evidence of underperformance a boundedly rational management would usually continue it for another year.
Its multifunctional character matches the firm's barrier-free and system-solution strategy, so it is likely to stay unless results clearly disappoint.
Although it appears less differentiated than some other launches, there is still too little evidence of failure for management to redeploy resources away from it immediately.
The dedicated presentation and the 2023 German Design Award suggest performance above aspiration and make withdrawal within a year very unlikely.
As a finish extension that complements coordinated product families and premium architectural demand, it likely remains on offer unless uptake proves distinctly weak.
